Damaghosha.note: King of Chedi; husband of Shrutashrava and father of Shishupala. His son's death was foretold at birth — a third eye and four arms that would vanish, and his killer named, the moment the boy sat on a particular lap; Krishna's was the lap, and Shishupala's murder-death both took the extra limbs away and, a hundred insults later, ended him at Krishna's hand.

people.Shishupala: King of Chedi, cousin of Krishna; born three-eyed and four-armed under a doom that Krishna would kill him, which came to pass at Yudhishthira's rajasuya after his hundredth insult.

Karenumati.note: A princess of Chedi; wife of Nakula.

people.Dhrishtaketu: Son of Shishupala; king of Chedi after his father and an ally of the Pandavas in the war.

Kushamba.note: Son of Uparichara Vasu, a king of Chedi. SB 9.22.6

Pratyagra.note: Son of Uparichara Vasu, a king of Chedi. SB 9.22.6

Cedipa.note: Son of Uparichara Vasu; a ruler of Chedi, from whom the later Chedi—Caidya kings descend, Shishupala's line among them.

Vriddhasharma.note: King of Karusha, husband of Shrutadeva and father of Dantavakra. SB 9.24.37

unions.note: Cedipa's line runs down to Damaghosha of Chedi, father of Shishupala. SB 9.22.6
